requirements.title: Sign in with valid credentials
when: the user signs in with a valid username and password

expected.text: the requests page `/` is shown with the heading "Requests"
the header shows "Signed in as Alice (requester)"

requirements.title: Reject invalid credentials
when: the user signs in with a wrong password

expected.text: the alert "Invalid username or password" is shown
the user stays on `/login`
the user is redirected to `/login`
`GET /api/requests` without a session returns HTTP 401

requirements.title: Create a purchase request
when: the requester submits "New request" with a title and an amount of 250

expected.text: the request detail page shows the title and the status "Pending"
the request appears on the requests page `/` with the status "Pending"

requirements.title: Title is required
when: the requester submits "New request" with an empty title and an amount of 250

expected.text: the alert "Title is required" is shown
no request is created

requirements.title: Amount limits
when: the requester submits "New request" with a title and the amount under test

expected.text: the request detail page shows the status "Pending"
expected.label: accepted

expected.text: the alert "Amount must be a whole number between 1 and 10000" is shown
expected.label: rejected

rules: the amount must be a whole number from 1 to 10000 (inclusive)

requirements.title: Requests are easy to find
notes: Note: stakeholders want requests to be "easy to find"; no measurable expected result has been agreed yet.

requirements.title: Approver approves a pending request
given: a pending request created by the requester
when: the approver opens the request and clicks "Approve"

expected.text: the request status is "Approved"
the requester sees the status "Approved" for that request

requirements.title: Approver rejects with a reason
given: a pending request created by the requester
when: the approver enters a reason and clicks "Reject"

expected.text: the request status is "Rejected" and the reason is shown
rejecting without a reason returns HTTP 400 from `POST /api/requests/<id>/reject`

requirements.title: Only approvers can decide
when: a requester or viewer tries to approve it

expected.text: no "Approve" button is shown to them
`POST /api/requests/<id>/approve` returns HTTP 403 for them
the request stays "Pending"
the viewer sees all requests on `/`
the viewer has no "New request" link
`POST /api/requests` returns HTTP 403 for the viewer

requirements.title: Decision is visible in another tab
given: a pending request created by the requester
when: the approver opens the request and clicks "Approve"

expected.text: the requester sees the status "Approved" for that request in a second tab
